scope: Exact affine repetition divisibility, finite inverse sources, and exact finite-list recursion.
excluded_scope: Binary-word compilation and physicality, sharp valuation cutoff, zero-run and automata deductions, Corvaja-Zannier, and analytic theorems remain written proofs.
dependency_scope: Reused installed compiled Mathlib and package dependencies; only the two named project sources were freshly compiled.

commands.stdout_without_import_listing:
CollatzBoundedLanguage.correction_identity (u v c : ℤ) (e : ℕ) : (v - u) * correction u v c e = c * (v ^ e - u ^ e)
CollatzBoundedLanguage.defect_identity {u v c q m : ℤ} {e : ℕ} (h : Reaches u v c e q m) :
  u ^ e * ((v - u) * q - c) = v ^ e * ((v - u) * m - c)
CollatzBoundedLanguage.numerator_defect_identity (u v c m : ℤ) (e : ℕ) :
  (v - u) * (v ^ e * m - correction u v c e) = v ^ e * ((v - u) * m - c) + c * u ^ e
CollatzBoundedLanguage.exists_reaches_iff_dvd {u v c m : ℤ} (hc : IsCoprime u v) (e : ℕ) :
  (∃ q, Reaches u v c e q m) ↔ u ^ e ∣ (v - u) * m - c
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.ofCounts (s L : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (hs : 0 < s) : Block
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.reaches_unique (b : Block) {e : ℕ} {q₁ q₂ m : ℤ} (h₁ : Reaches (↑b.u) b.v b.c e q₁ m)
  (h₂ : Reaches (↑b.u) b.v b.c e q₂ m) : q₁ = q₂
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.preimage_reaches_iff_dvd (b : Block) (e : ℕ) (m : ℤ) :
  Reaches (↑b.u) b.v b.c e (b.preimage e m) m ↔ ↑b.u ^ e ∣ b.defect m
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.zero_defect_source (b : Block) {m q : ℤ} {e : ℕ} (hm : b.defect m = 0)
  (hq : Reaches (↑b.u) b.v b.c e q m) : q = m
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.exponent_lt_defect (b : Block) {m q : ℤ} {e : ℕ} (hm : b.defect m ≠ 0)
  (hq : Reaches (↑b.u) b.v b.c e q m) : e < (b.defect m).natAbs
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.sources_finite (b : Block) (m : ℤ) : (b.Sources m).Finite
CollatzBoundedLanguage.Block.mem_inverseFinset (b : Block) (q m : ℤ) : q ∈ b.inverseFinset m ↔ q ∈ b.Sources m
CollatzBoundedLanguage.sources_finite (bs : List Block) (m : ℤ) : (Sources bs m).Finite
CollatzBoundedLanguage.mem_inverseFinset (bs : List Block) (q m : ℤ) : q ∈ inverseFinset bs m ↔ q ∈ Sources bs m
